rules.statement: A deed that grants property to a donee with the children and their heirs, executors, administrators and assigns having the right to possess or do whatever they please with the property does not necessarily create a fideicommissum.
rules.supporting_quote: "Instead, the persons to be benefited being the children of the donee, he expressed the view that the additional words 'their (i.e., the children's) heirs, executors, administrators and assigns' could be construed as used for the purpose of conferring on the children an absolute and unfettered right in the property conveyed."
